gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all issue type schemes available in the Jira Cloud platform so that I can understand the configurations and options for my projects.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all issue type schemes with their respective IDs and names.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to create a new issue type scheme to better organize the issue types for my team’s projects.
gold.ideal: The API should create a new issue type scheme and return the details of the created scheme, including its ID and name.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to get the mapping of issue type schemes to ensure that I am using the correct issue types for my project.
gold.ideal: The API should return a mapping of issue type schemes to their respective projects, showing which schemes are assigned to which projects.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to find out which issue type scheme is assigned to my project to ensure that the right issue types are available.
gold.ideal: The API should return the issue type scheme assigned to the specified project, including the scheme's ID and name.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to assign a specific issue type scheme to my project to customize the issue types available for my team.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully assign the specified issue type scheme to the project and return a confirmation message.

gold.user: As an administrator, I want to delete an obsolete issue type scheme that is no longer in use to keep the system clean.
gold.ideal: The API should delete the specified issue type scheme and return a success message confirming the deletion.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to update the details of an existing issue type scheme to reflect changes in our project requirements.
gold.ideal: The API should update the specified issue type scheme and return the updated details, including the new name and configuration.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to add new issue types to an existing issue type scheme to expand the options available for my team.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully add the specified issue types to the issue type scheme and return the updated list of issue types.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to reorder the issue types in an issue type scheme to prioritize certain types for my team’s workflow.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully reorder the issue types in the specified scheme and return the new order.

gold.user: As an administrator, I want to remove an issue type from an issue type scheme that is no longer relevant to our projects.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully remove the specified issue type from the issue type scheme and return a confirmation message.
